checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Lit candle in frosted jar is centered and largest.
Jar and flame are well defined; the label text is garbled but shapes are fine.
Only lavender and eucalyptus props on marble.

must.item: Controlled lighting and coordinated background, polished retail look
must.why: Soft light, beige and marble palette, cohesive styling.

faults.what: Label has garbled pseudo-text ('BEONDIOK', 'Scunini Bor'). The assistant described it as a plain label, but it has text. A client would notice this.

summary: A polished, well-lit lit-candle product shot with a clean composition; the main flaw is the gibberish text on the label, which also contradicts the "plain label" description.
